description: Geopolitical leaders, officials, and institutions monitored for market-moving posts across influence platforms (TruthSocial and X/Twitter). Entities are ranked by relevance (mention frequency + market-moving potential) with official platform handles and power-expiration dates (next election/term end; N/A if not subject to a competitive electoral term). The rank-0 primary influence account is listed separately under primary_accounts.
source: trump_truths.csv (spaCy NER PERSON extraction over 7333 posts)

primary_accounts.name: Donald J. Trump
primary_accounts.note: Rank-0 primary influence account. Currently 47th U.S. President, Republican/MAGA aligned. Posts on TruthSocial. Rank-0 status is assigned to whoever holds the primary influence position — future rank-0 may differ (e.g. next U.S. president regardless of party, or a successor candidate).

institutions.description: Government departments, militaries, and embassy/MFA accounts on X/Twitter that often break geopolitical news (e.g. military incidents, strikes, casualties) before or independent of any individual leader's account — relevant for early-signal market monitoring.

entries.name: U.S. Department of War (formerly Department of Defense / Pentagon)
entries.note: Renamed from @DeptofDefense per Sept 2025 executive order; fallback @DeptofDefense if handle not found. Often first to confirm/deny military incidents (e.g. aircraft crashes, strikes)

entries.name: Israel Defense Forces (IDF)
entries.note: Frequently first to report strikes, operations, and military incidents in real time
